name: Sleepy Time Jack: Digital Talking Body Pillow
source:
~ even the sun needs a little rest to rise and be bright ~

Sleepy Time Jack is a Digital Talking Body Pillow, or a Sleep ASMR App, based on Something's Wrong With Sunny Day Jack, featuring the titular main character known as Jack. Fall asleep to the soothing sound of your Sunny Day Jack's voice as he praises and comforts you in this Digital Talking Body Pillow app!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2256370/Sleepy_Time_Jack_Digital_Talking_Body_Pillow/]Steam[/url]]
